ko.L: 그러므로 여러분은 회개하고 돌이키십시오. 그래서 여러분의 죄가 지워지게 하십시오. \v 20 그러면 주님 앞에서 새 힘을 얻는 때가 오고, 주님께서 여러분을 위하여 미리 정하신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, 곧 예수를 보내실 것입니다. \v 21 하나님께서 옛날부터 그분의 거룩한 예언자들의 입을 통하여 말씀하신 모든 것이 회복될 때까지, 하늘이 그분을 맞아들여야 합니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 여러분은 회개하고 하나님께 돌아오십시오. 그러면 여러분의 죄가 씻은 듯이 지워질 것입니다. \v 20 그리고 주님께로부터 새 힘을 얻는 때가 올 것이며, 주님께서 여러분을 위하여 미리 정하신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, 곧 예수를 보내 주실 것입니다. \v 21 예수께서는 하늘에 받아들여져, 모든 것이 새롭게 회복될 때까지 거기 계셔야 합니다. 하나님께서는 이것을 오래전에 그분의 거룩한 예언자들의 입을 통하여 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오십시오. 그러면 하나님께서 여러분의 죄를 깨끗이 지워 주실 것입니다. \v 20 그리고 주님께서 여러분에게 쉼과 새 힘을 주시는 때가 올 것입니다. 또 주님께서 여러분을 위하여 뽑으신 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}, 곧 예수를 여러분에게 보내 주실 것입니다. \v 21 그러나 예수께서는 하나님께서 모든 것을 다시 바로잡으실 때까지 하늘에 계셔야 합니다. 하나님께서 오래전에 그분의 거룩한 예언자들을 통하여 이것을 약속하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: turn back: return to God
decisions.reason: The prophets call Israel to turn back to God (Isaiah 55:7; Jeremiah 3:12).

decisions.choice: wiped out: erased, as writing is wiped from a page
decisions.reason: Psalm 51:3, 51:11 and Isaiah 43:25 speak of God blotting out sins.

decisions.choice: times of refreshing: seasons of relief and rest that God gives
alternatives: only a time at the end
decisions.reason: The word means a breathing space, relief. It may be the blessing that comes now to those who repent, or the age to come when Jesus returns; the sentence goes on to his coming.

decisions.choice: appointed beforehand: chosen in advance
decisions.reason: God chose Jesus beforehand to be the Messiah for Israel.

decisions.choice: heaven must receive him: Jesus stays in heaven until then
decisions.reason: The grammar allows either, but Jesus has been taken up into heaven (1:11), where he remains until he comes again.

decisions.choice: the restoration of all things: God setting everything right
alternatives: the return of every person to God
decisions.reason: The word is related to "restore" in 1:6. The prophets spoke of God renewing his people and his world (Isaiah 65:17; Malachi 4:6).

decisions.choice: turn away from your sins and come back to God
decisions.reason: Readable says what both verbs mean together.

decisions.choice: Jesus must be welcomed into heaven (B); Jesus must stay in heaven (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jesus and keep him as the subject.

decisions.choice: arrepiéntanse... y vuélvanse (L, B); apártense de sus pecados y vuelvan a Dios (R)
decisions.reason: "Arrepentirse" is the book-wide word for repenting; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does (its decision r-en-1, meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: tiempos de alivio
decisions.reason: Seasons of relief and rest that God gives (meaning decision m3); "refrigerio" now suggests a snack.

decisions.choice: tubuni na kugeuka (L, B); acheni dhambi zenu, mrudi kwa Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "Kutubu" is the book-wide word for repenting; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does (its decision r-en-1, meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: nyakati za nafuu
decisions.reason: Seasons of relief and rest that God gives (meaning decision m3); "nafuu" is relief after hardship or sickness.

decisions.choice: "được xóa sạch" (L), "được xóa bỏ" (B) for sins wiped out
decisions.reason: The picture is writing wiped from a page (meaning decision), which "xóa" keeps.

decisions.choice: "những kỳ tươi mới" (L); "những kỳ thư thái" (B); "được nghỉ ngơi và có sức mới" (R)
decisions.reason: Seasons of relief and rest that God gives (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "회개하고 돌이키다" (L), "회개하고 하나님께 돌아오다" (B), "죄에서 돌이켜 하나님께 돌아오다" (R); "지워지다"; "새 힘을 얻는 때" (L, B), "쉼과 새 힘을 주시는 때" (R)
decisions.reason: To turn back is to return to God; sins wiped out as writing is wiped from a page; times of refreshing are seasons of relief and rest that God gives (meaning decisions).

decisions.choice: "하늘이 그분을 맞아들여야 합니다" (L); "하늘에 받아들여져 ... 거기 계셔야 합니다" (B)
decisions.reason: Heaven must receive him: Jesus stays in heaven until then (meaning decision). Literal keeps heaven as the subject; Balanced and Readable say where Jesus is, as the English does.

source.text: Μωϋσῆς μὲν εἶπεν ὅτι Προφήτην ὑμῖν ἀναστήσει κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν ὡς ἐμέ· αὐτοῦ ἀκούσεσθε κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἂν λαλήσῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: Moses indeed said, A prophet for you will raise up Lord the God of you from the brothers of you like me; him you will listen to in all things whatever he may speak to you.

en.L: Moses said, 'A prophet [the] Lord your God will raise up for you from your brothers, like me. You shall listen to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in all things, whatever {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} may say to you.
en.B: Moses himself said, 'From among your own people the Lord your God will raise up a prophet for you, one like me. Whatever {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says to you, you must heed {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in all of it.
en.R: Moses said, 'The Lord your God will give you a prophet like me. He will come from your own people. You must listen to everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tells you.

es.L: Moisés dijo: “Un profeta {{plural_you:les|os}} levantará [el] Señor {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios de entre {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos, como yo; a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:escucharán|escucharéis}} en todo cuanto {{plural_you:les|os}} hable.
es.B: Moisés mismo dijo: “El Señor {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} levantará de entre {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} propio pueblo un profeta como yo. {{plural_you:Deberán escucharlo|Deberéis escucharlo}} en todo lo que {{plural_you:les|os}} diga.
es.R: Moisés dijo: “El Señor {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dará un profeta como yo. Saldrá de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} propio pueblo. {{plural_you:Tienen|Tenéis}} que escuchar todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} diga.

fr.L: Moïse a dit : “Un prophète, le Seigneur votre Dieu vous [le] suscitera d’entre vos frères, comme moi. Lui, vous {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}écouterez en tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous dira.
fr.B: Moïse lui-même a dit : “Du milieu de votre propre peuple, le Seigneur votre Dieu fera se lever pour vous un prophète semblable à moi. Quoi qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous dise, écoutez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} en tout.
fr.R: Moïse a dit : “Le Seigneur votre Dieu vous donnera un prophète comme moi. Il viendra de votre propre peuple. Vous devrez écouter tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vous dira.

sw.L: Musa alisema kwamba, 'Nabii, Bwana Mungu wenu atawainulia kutoka miongoni mwa ndugu zenu, kama mimi; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mtamsikiliza katika mambo yote atakayowaambia.
sw.B: Musa mwenyewe alisema, 'Bwana Mungu wenu atawainulia nabii kama mimi kutoka miongoni mwa watu wenu wenyewe. Mtamsikiliza katika kila jambo atakalowaambia.
sw.R: Musa alisema, 'Bwana Mungu wenu atawapa nabii kama mimi. Atatoka miongoni mwa watu wenu wenyewe. Ni lazima mumsikilize katika kila jambo atakalowaambia.

vi.L: Môi-se đã nói: 'Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ dấy lên cho anh em một nhà tiên tri giống như tôi từ giữa vòng anh em mình; anh em phải nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với anh em.
vi.B: Chính Môi-se đã nói: 'Từ giữa dân tộc của anh em, Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ dấy lên cho anh em một nhà tiên tri giống như tôi. Anh em phải nghe theo mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với anh em.
vi.R: Môi-se đã nói: 'Chúa là Đức Chúa Trời của anh em sẽ ban cho anh em một nhà tiên tri giống như tôi. Nhà tiên tri ấy sẽ ra từ chính dân tộc của anh em. Anh em phải nghe theo mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói với anh em.

ko.L: 모세가 말했습니다. '주 너희의 하나님께서 너희를 위하여 너희 형제들 가운데서 나와 같은 예언자를 일으키실 것이다. 그가 너희에게 무엇을 말하든지, 너희는 모든 일에서 그의 말을 들어야 한다.
ko.B: 모세도 이렇게 말했습니다. '주 너희의 하나님께서 너희 동족 가운데서 나와 같은 예언자 한 사람을 너희에게 세워 주실 것이다. 그가 너희에게 하는 말은 무엇이든지 다 들어야 한다.
ko.R: 모세는 이렇게 말했습니다. '주 너희의 하나님께서 너희에게 나와 같은 예언자를 보내 주실 것이다. 그는 너희 백성 가운데서 나올 것이다. 너희는 그가 하는 말을 모두 들어야 한다.

decisions.choice: Deuteronomy 18:15-19: the prophet like Moses
decisions.reason: Moses promised that God would raise up a prophet like him. Peter quotes the Greek Old Testament freely and runs on into 3:23.

decisions.choice: the prophet like Moses is Jesus
decisions.reason: Stephen applies the same words to Jesus (7:37). At the transfiguration the voice says, "Listen to him" (Luke 9:35).

decisions.choice: will raise up: bring onto the scene
decisions.reason: In Deuteronomy the verb means to bring a prophet forward. Peter may hear the resurrection in it too (3:26).

decisions.choice: your brothers: your own people, Israel
decisions.reason: The prophet would be an Israelite.

decisions.choice: your own people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "brothers" means here; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: Moses says "tôi" and "anh em" to Israel in the quotation of Deuteronomy 18
decisions.reason: Moses speaks as one of the people to his own people, so his words take the forms a leader uses with his kin; "các ngươi" is kept for God's own words (2:17-21).

decisions.choice: Moses speaks to Israel in 해라체 ("너희", "들어야 한다"), and speaks of the coming prophet with no honorific ("그"); "형제들" (L), "동족" (B), "너희 백성" (R)
decisions.reason: Moses speaks of a prophet like himself; the Korean keeps his words as he spoke them, and Peter's reading of them as Jesus (meaning decision) is told in 3:26. Your brothers are your own people (meaning decision), so there is no gender span.

decisions.choice: "주 너희의 하나님" for kyrios, with no divine_name span
decisions.reason: As the Korean Luke 10:27, the New Testament's "kyrios" is "주", even where it quotes a verse with the divine name.

source.text: ἔσται δὲ πᾶσα ψυχὴ ἥτις ἂν μὴ ἀκούσῃ τοῦ προφήτου ἐκείνου ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: It will be now every soul who not listens to the prophet that will be utterly destroyed from the people.

en.L: And it will be [that] every soul that does not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.'
en.B: Every person who refuses to heed that prophet will be destroyed and removed from the people.'
en.R: Anyone who does not listen to that prophet will be destroyed and will no longer belong to God's people.'

es.L: Y sucederá [que] toda alma que no escuche a aquel profeta será exterminada de entre el pueblo”.
es.B: Toda persona que se niegue a escuchar a ese profeta será destruida y apartada del pueblo”.
es.R: Cualquiera que no escuche a ese profeta será destruido y ya no pertenecerá al pueblo de Dios”.

fr.L: Et il arrivera [que] toute âme qui n’écoutera pas ce prophète sera exterminée du milieu du peuple.”
fr.B: Toute personne qui refusera d’écouter ce prophète sera détruite et retranchée du peuple.”
fr.R: Celui qui n’écoutera pas ce prophète sera détruit et ne fera plus partie du peuple de Dieu.”

sw.L: Na itakuwa [kwamba] kila nafsi isiyomsikiliza nabii huyo itaangamizwa kabisa kutoka miongoni mwa watu.'
sw.B: Kila mtu atakayekataa kumsikiliza nabii huyo ataangamizwa na kuondolewa kutoka miongoni mwa watu.'
sw.R: Mtu yeyote asiyemsikiliza nabii huyo ataangamizwa, wala hatakuwa tena miongoni mwa watu wa Mungu.'

vi.L: Và người nào không nghe nhà tiên tri ấy sẽ bị diệt trừ khỏi dân chúng.'
vi.B: Ai không chịu nghe nhà tiên tri ấy sẽ bị tiêu diệt và loại ra khỏi dân Chúa.'
vi.R: Ai không nghe nhà tiên tri ấy sẽ bị tiêu diệt và không còn thuộc về dân của Đức Chúa Trời nữa.'

ko.L: 그리고 그 예언자의 말을 듣지 않는 영혼은 누구든지 백성 가운데서 완전히 멸망할 것이다.'
ko.B: 누구든지 그 예언자의 말을 듣지 않는 사람은 멸망하여 백성 가운데서 끊어질 것이다.'
ko.R: 누구든지 그 예언자의 말을 듣지 않는 사람은 멸망할 것이다. 그 사람은 더 이상 하나님의 백성에 속하지 못할 것이다.'

decisions.choice: utterly destroyed from the people: the words of Leviticus 23:29
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 18:19 says God will call to account anyone who will not listen. Peter takes the stronger words from Leviticus 23:29, where they are spoken of anyone who does not humble himself on the Day of Atonement.

decisions.choice: every soul: every person
decisions.reason: As at 2:41.

decisions.choice: will no longer belong to God's people
decisions.reason: Readable says what being destroyed "from the people" means.

decisions.choice: "người nào" (L) for "every soul"
decisions.reason: "Every soul" means every person (meaning decision), as in 2:41.

source.text: καὶ πάντες δὲ οἱ προφῆται ἀπὸ Σαμουὴλ καὶ τῶν καθεξῆς ὅσοι ἐλάλησαν καὶ κατήγγειλαν τὰς ἡμέρας ταύτας.

records.literal_gloss: And all now the prophets from Samuel and those following, as many as spoke, also announced the days these.

en.L: And also all the prophets from Samuel and those after [him], as many as have spoken, also announced these days.
en.B: And every prophet who has spoken, from Samuel on through those who followed him, has also told of these days.
en.R: Samuel and all the other prophets after him spoke about what is happening now.

es.L: Y también todos los profetas desde Samuel y los que [le] siguieron, cuantos hablaron, también anunciaron estos días.
es.B: Y todos los profetas que han hablado, desde Samuel y los que vinieron después de él, también anunciaron estos días.
es.R: Samuel y todos los demás profetas que vinieron después de él hablaron de lo que está pasando ahora.

fr.L: Et aussi tous les prophètes depuis Samuel et ceux qui [l’]ont suivi, tous ceux qui ont parlé, ont aussi annoncé ces jours-ci.
fr.B: Et tous les prophètes qui ont parlé, depuis Samuel et ceux qui l’ont suivi, ont eux aussi annoncé ces jours.
fr.R: Samuel et tous les autres prophètes après lui ont parlé de ce qui arrive maintenant.

sw.L: Na pia manabii wote tangu Samweli na wale waliofuata baada [yake], wote walionena, walitangaza pia siku hizi.
sw.B: Na kila nabii aliyenena, tangu Samweli na wale waliomfuata, ametangaza pia habari za siku hizi.
sw.R: Samweli na manabii wengine wote waliokuja baada yake walisema juu ya mambo yanayotokea sasa.

vi.L: Và cũng vậy, tất cả các nhà tiên tri từ Sa-mu-ên và những người kế tiếp, hết thảy những ai đã nói, cũng đã báo trước về những ngày này.
vi.B: Tất cả các nhà tiên tri đã nói, từ Sa-mu-ên đến những người kế tiếp ông, cũng đều đã báo trước về những ngày này.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên và tất cả các nhà tiên tri khác đến sau ông đều đã nói về những điều đang xảy ra bây giờ.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘과 그 뒤를 이은 모든 예언자도, 말한 사람은 누구나 이날들을 알렸습니다.
ko.B: 사무엘을 비롯하여 그 뒤를 이어 말씀을 전한 예언자들도 모두 이날들에 관하여 미리 알렸습니다.
ko.R: 사무엘과 그 뒤에 온 다른 예언자들도 모두 지금 일어나고 있는 일에 관하여 말했습니다.

decisions.choice: Samuel: the first of the prophets after Moses
decisions.reason: Samuel was known as a prophet throughout Israel (1 Samuel 3:20; Acts 13:20). He anointed David, to whom God's promise was given (1 Samuel 16:13; 2 Samuel 7).

decisions.choice: these days: the time now begun with Jesus
decisions.reason: As Joel's "last days" have begun (2:17).

source.text: ὑμεῖς ἐστε οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν προφητῶν καὶ τῆς διαθήκης ἧς διέθετο ὁ θεὸς πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας ὑμῶν, λέγων πρὸς Ἀβραάμ Καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου ἐνευλογηθήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ πατριαὶ τῆς γῆς.

records.literal_gloss: You are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant which made the God with the fathers of you, saying to Abraham, And in the seed of you will be blessed all the families of the earth.

en.L: You are the sons of the prophets and of the covenant that God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, 'And in your seed all the families of the earth will be blessed.'
en.B: You are the {{gender:children|sons}} of the prophets and of the covenant God made with your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} said to Abraham, 'All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.'
en.R: You are the {{gender:children|sons}} of the prophets. The covenant God made with your {{gender:ancestors|fathers}} belongs to you. God said to Abraham, 'Through your family all the families on earth will be blessed.'

es.L: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} los hijos de los profetas y del pacto que Dios estableció con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres, diciéndole a Abraham: “Y en tu descendencia serán bendecidas todas las familias de la tierra”.
es.B: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} los hijos de los profetas y del pacto que Dios hizo con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} {{gender:antepasados|padres}} cuando le dijo a Abraham: “Por medio de tu descendencia serán bendecidas todas las familias de la tierra”.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes son|Vosotros sois}} los hijos de los profetas. El pacto que Dios hizo con {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} {{gender:antepasados|padres}} es para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Dios le dijo a Abraham: “Por medio de tu familia serán bendecidas todas las familias de la tierra”.

fr.L: Vous êtes les fils des prophètes et de l’alliance que Dieu a conclue avec vos pères, en disant à Abraham : “Et en ta semence seront bénies toutes les familles de la terre.”
fr.B: Vous êtes les {{gender:enfants|fils}} des prophètes et de l’alliance que Dieu a conclue avec vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}}, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit à Abraham : “Toutes les familles de la terre seront bénies par ta descendance.”
fr.R: Vous êtes les {{gender:enfants|fils}} des prophètes. L’alliance que Dieu a faite avec vos {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} est pour vous. Dieu a dit à Abraham : “Par ta famille, toutes les familles de la terre seront bénies.”

sw.L: Ninyi ndio wana wa manabii na wa agano lile Mungu alilofanya pamoja na baba zenu, alipomwambia Ibrahimu, 'Na kupitia uzao wako koo zote za dunia zitabarikiwa.'
sw.B: Ninyi ni wana wa manabii na wa agano ambalo Mungu alifanya na mababu zenu, alipomwambia Ibrahimu, 'Koo zote za dunia zitabarikiwa kupitia uzao wako.'
sw.R: Ninyi ni watoto wa manabii. Agano ambalo Mungu alifanya na mababu zenu ni lenu. Mungu alimwambia Ibrahimu, 'Kupitia familia yako, familia zote za duniani zitabarikiwa.'

vi.L: Anh em là con cháu của các nhà tiên tri và của giao ước mà Đức Chúa Trời đã lập với tổ phụ anh em, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với Áp-ra-ham: 'Và trong dòng dõi con, mọi gia tộc trên đất sẽ được phước.'
vi.B: Anh em là con cháu của các nhà tiên tri và của giao ước Đức Chúa Trời đã lập với tổ tiên anh em, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán với Áp-ra-ham: 'Nhờ dòng dõi con, mọi gia tộc trên đất sẽ được phước.'
vi.R: Anh em là con cháu của các nhà tiên tri. Giao ước Đức Chúa Trời đã lập với tổ tiên anh em cũng thuộc về anh em. Đức Chúa Trời đã phán với Áp-ra-ham: 'Nhờ dòng dõi của con, mọi gia tộc trên đất sẽ được phước.'

ko.L: 여러분은 예언자들의 아들들이요, 하나님께서 여러분의 조상들과 맺으신 언약의 아들들입니다. 하나님께서 아브라함에게 '네 씨 안에서 땅의 모든 족속이 복을 받을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 예언자들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들이며, 하나님께서 여러분의 조상들과 맺으신 언약의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들입니다. 하나님께서는 아브라함에게 '네 자손으로 말미암아 땅의 모든 족속이 복을 받을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨습니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 예언자들의 {{gender:자녀|아들}}들입니다. 하나님께서 여러분의 조상들과 맺으신 언약도 여러분의 것입니다. 하나님께서는 아브라함에게 '네 자손을 통하여 땅의 모든 족속이 복을 받을 것이다' 하고 말씀하셨습니다.

decisions.choice: sons of the prophets and of the covenant: those to whom they belong
decisions.reason: "Sons of" here means heirs: the prophets spoke to them, and the covenant was made for them.

decisions.choice: God's promise to Abraham: Genesis 22:18, with 12:3
decisions.reason: Genesis 22:18 has "in your seed all the nations of the earth will be blessed"; Genesis 12:3 and 28:14 have "families".

decisions.choice: seed: offspring, Abraham's descendants, and Jesus as the one descendant
decisions.reason: The word is singular and can mean many descendants or one. 3:26 points to Jesus, through whom the blessing comes; Paul makes the point in Galatians 3:16.

decisions.choice: covenant: the binding promise God made
decisions.reason: God set the covenant and bound himself by it (Genesis 15, 17).

decisions.choice: children and ancestors, with "sons" and "fathers" as the alternatives
decisions.reason: The words mean the whole people, men and women; Literal keeps them.

decisions.choice: hijos, no setting
decisions.reason: Spanish "hijos" already takes in sons and daughters, so the English children / sons span has no Spanish counterpart; "antepasados / padres" keeps its span, as in 3:13.

decisions.choice: descendencia (L, B); familia (R)
decisions.reason: The word is Abraham's offspring, with Jesus as the one descendant in view (meaning decision m3); "descendencia" keeps both, where "simiente" is now only a farming word.

decisions.choice: l’alliance at every level (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles: "l’alliance" is the French word for God's binding promise (m4); "le testament" now means a will, and "le pacte" sounds like a human treaty.

decisions.choice: ta semence (L); ta descendance (B); ta famille (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of seed, singular, which leaves open the reading of one descendant (m3, uncertain); Balanced and Readable say what it means in current French.

decisions.choice: koo (L, B); familia (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek word is a clan or extended family, the families of the earth; "koo" (clans) says that, where "mataifa" would be nations.

decisions.choice: "con cháu" for "sons", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Sons of the prophets and of the covenant" means those they belong to (meaning decision); "con cháu" already includes daughters, so the English setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: God speaks to Abraham as "con" and the blessing is worded as in the Vietnamese Galatians 3:8: "mọi ... sẽ được phước"
decisions.reason: The promise to Abraham is quoted in Galatians 3:8 too; the wording is shared, with "gia tộc" here for the different Greek word "families".

decisions.choice: {{gender:자녀|아들}}들 (B, R), with "아들들" at Literal; "조상들" with no span
decisions.reason: The settled Korean span for "sons" meaning sons and daughters, as the English Balanced and Readable have one; the plural ending stays outside it. "조상" is inclusive already.

decisions.choice: "씨" (L), "자손" (B, R); "족속" for patriai
decisions.reason: Seed means offspring, and Jesus as the one descendant (meaning decision); "씨" keeps the singular picture at Literal. The promise is worded close to the Korean Galatians 3:8, which quotes Genesis 12:3, but this verse has "families", not "nations".

source.text: ὑμῖν πρῶτον ἀναστήσας ὁ θεὸς τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εὐλογοῦντα ὑμᾶς ἐν τῷ ἀποστρέφειν ἕκαστον ἀπὸ τῶν πονηριῶν ὑμῶν.

records.literal_gloss: To you first, having raised up the God the servant of him, sent him blessing you in the to turn away each from the wickednesses of you.

en.L: To you first God, having raised up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant, sent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, blessing you in turning each [of you] away from your wicked deeds."
en.B: It was for you first that God raised up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant and sent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to bless you, turning each one of you away from your evil deeds."
en.R: God raised up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servant Jesus and sent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to you first. He sent {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to bless you by turning each of you away from the evil things you do."

es.L: Para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} primero, Dios, habiendo levantado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} envió {{plural_you:bendiciéndolos|bendiciéndoos}} al apartar a cada uno [de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}] de {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} maldades».
es.B: Fue para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} primero que Dios levantó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} envió a {{plural_you:bendecirlos|bendeciros}}, apartando a cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} de {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} malas obras».
es.R: Dios levantó a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} siervo Jesús y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} envió primero a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Lo envió para {{plural_you:bendecirlos|bendeciros}}, haciendo que cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} deje las cosas malas que {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}».

fr.L: C’est à vous d’abord que Dieu, ayant suscité {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a envoyé vous bénir, en détournant chacun [de vous] de vos méchancetés. »
fr.B: C’est pour vous d’abord que Dieu a suscité {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a envoyé vous bénir, en détournant chacun de vous de ses mauvaises actions. »
fr.R: Dieu a fait se lever {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} serviteur Jésus et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a envoyé d’abord vers vous. Il {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}a envoyé pour vous bénir, en détournant chacun de vous du mal que vous faites. »

sw.L: Kwenu kwanza Mungu, akiisha kumwinua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, alimtuma akiwabariki kwa kumgeuza kila mmoja [wenu] kutoka katika maovu yenu."
sw.B: Ni kwenu kwanza Mungu alimwinua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kumtuma awabariki, kwa kumgeuza kila mmoja wenu aache matendo yake maovu."
sw.R: Mungu alimwinua mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Yesu, akamtuma kwenu kwanza. Alimtuma awabariki kwa kumgeuza kila mmoja wenu aache mambo maovu anayofanya."

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời đã dấy Đầy Tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lên và sai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với anh em trước hết, để ban phước cho anh em, bằng cách làm cho mỗi người trong anh em quay lưng khỏi những điều gian ác của mình."

decisions.choice: raised up: brought forward as the promised prophet, and raised from the dead
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the prophet in 3:22, and of the resurrection in 2:24 and 2:32.

decisions.choice: to you first: to Israel first, and then to the nations
decisions.reason: The blessing promised to "all the families of the earth" (3:25) begins with Israel (13:46; Romans 1:16).

decisions.choice: in turning each of you away: Jesus turns them from evil
alternatives: as each of you turns away
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to turn someone else away or to turn oneself. The blessing is the turning itself.

decisions.choice: servant: as in 3:13
decisions.reason: The same word and the same title from Isaiah.

decisions.choice: his servant Jesus
decisions.reason: Readable names him.

decisions.choice: "먼저 여러분에게"; "일으키다" (L), "세우다" (B, R) for anistēmi; "종" as in 3:13
decisions.reason: Raised up means brought forward as the promised prophet, and also raised from the dead (meaning decision); "일으키다" keeps both at Literal, as in 3:22.
